reason: Mechanism verified at HEAD 2e23b46 (source.go:110 uses alphanumericPattern(len(value)) as model.Source.Pattern; source.go:213-214/279-293 slice the same fixed alphabet for evidence ValuePart.Pattern; no check compares pattern to value). Independently reproduced twice: (1) unit test with the real default redaction configuration — serialized event contains "pattern":"abc","redacted":true for a password source whose value is abc, in both the source and the evidence part; (2) woven orchestrion e2e on Go 1.26.6 — HTTP request parameter password=abc concatenated into a database/sql query yields a serialized vulnerability event containing the raw password "abc" as the redacted pattern. Leak requires the secret (or tainted substring) to equal a window of the fixed alphabet (e.g. a, ab, abc ... abcd...j), a narrow class that includes top-10 common passwords; for other secrets only length/offset metadata leaks. Not documented in README or phase1/01-design-intent.md; breaks the 'redacted before leaving the process' product rule. Single root cause distinct from phase-2 F2 (source name serialization) and F3 (SQL comment analyzer coverage).
